# Instructions

## General instructions source of truth (SSOT)

Read the external source of truth (SSOT) for general instructions from https://github.com/shlomoa/shlomoa/blob/main/.github/copilot-instructions.md It is mandatory.

## Copilot bootstrap

- Read and apply the external general instructions before applying repository-specific guidance.
- Read and apply `AGENTS.md` for repository-specific rules, key sources, and
  validation expectations.
- If instructions conflict, prefer the more specific repository guidance unless a higher-priority
  system, developer, or safety instruction requires otherwise.
